text.en: 1. This Order is the Infrastructure Protection (Protected Areas) (No. 2) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 7 October 2024.

heading.en: Premises declared to be protected area

text.en: 2. The premises described in the second column of the Schedule are declared to be a protected area for the purposes of the Act, and the person specified in the first column of that Schedule is designated as the authority of the protected area.
